mood: The day before, Obsidia sits alone in her throne hall and goes over every move she has planned.

hero.alt: Obsidia floats in a black gown with one clawed glove raised, a pink star glowing at her chest and her silver-pink weapon hanging in the air beside her.

media.alt: Obsidia sits back with one clawed glove stretched out, thin red threads hanging from its fingers, lightning in the storm behind her.
Obsidia looks back over her shoulder among floating shards of glass, a pink star burning at her chest.
